name: Rin'ji is Trapped!
summary: At Quel'Danil Lodge, Rin'ji has lost an axe and is held captive. Rin'ji asks a passer-by for help escaping, offers something in return, and speaks of a secret at the Overlook Cliffs.

sections.title: A Plea for Escape
sections.body: At Quel'Danil Lodge, Rin'ji is frightened and held captive. The axe is gone, so Rin'ji begs a passer-by to help escape. Many dislike Rin'ji's kind. Still, Rin'ji offers something to a kind soul who helps and says a secret lies hidden at the Overlook Cliffs.

sections.title: At the End of the Escape
sections.body: A troll tablet bears strange markings. No one can make out what the writing says.

aliases: who is the troll in quel'danil
faq.answer: Rin'ji is a troll who lost an axe and was captured at Quel'Danil Lodge in the Hinterlands. Rin'ji speaks of the self in the third person and begs a passer-by for help escaping.
Rin'ji is held captive at Quel'Danil Lodge in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What does Rin'ji offer for help?
faq.answer: Rin'ji offers something to those who help and says a secret is hidden at the Overlook Cliffs.
